claim: Ground rule: the fundamentals first, since supplements won't make up for not doing them

For energy, and really wellness, the fundamentals are: enough high quality sleep, a decent diet that fuels your body effectively, regular exercise, not wasting your sex energy, and meditating to keep stress in check
With the basics in place you're 70 to 80% of the way to the energy you desire; supplements can take us the rest of the way

The last decade went into taking dozens and dozens of supplements and researching, a lot of it around energy, since a lot of us are looking for more energy in our lives. Back in the day: energy drinks, and feeling absolutely horrible from them; years of mistakes and dialing things in followed
The personal top five supplements for real, healthy energy, in no particular order, or maybe in a particular order in this case
Coffee, one of the personal top five supplements for real, healthy energy, is amazing for energy, in a healthy way
For energy, coffee, and for hell's sake not soda: a morning can of soda is a completely different thing, and so is tea
For years a lot of people looked at coffee as maybe a vice, but more and more science has come to show it's very, very good for us, with a number of really well-proven benefits beyond energy
Coffee gives more mental and physical energy and a faster brain, at a moderate amount: a couple cups, not eight shots of espresso
A study shows a couple cups of coffee can cut post-workout muscle pain by up to 48%
Among the other scientifically proven benefits of coffee: associated with a lower risk of diabetes, Alzheimer's, MS and colorectal cancer
Among the other scientifically proven benefits of coffee: a really large study shows it reduces suicide risk and depression
Among the other scientifically proven benefits of coffee: studies show it protects against Parkinson's
Among the other scientifically proven benefits of coffee: coffee drinkers have shown in studies a lower risk of heart disease, and DNA of stronger integrity
Coffee can make you feel great and get more done
Coffee seems to have a place in every adult's life, and probably a lot of teenagers could benefit from a moderate amount
In your life coffee most definitely has a place: a huge source of energy beyond the basics
Acetyl-L-carnitine, one of the personal top five supplements for real, healthy energy, maybe not heard of, like the rest of the list: an amino acid
Carnitine is produced naturally in our body
Acetyl-L-carnitine's big role is with our mitochondria
Mitochondria are absolutely crucial to so much of our health, wellness and energy, with a lot of science around them now

On a cellular level mitochondria have a huge role in helping our body run effectively, so acetyl-L-carnitine, by essentially boosting them, basically boosts one of the most important aspects of virtually every cell
Almost every cell has mitochondria, and one of their major roles is energy production, so boosting them boosts energy on a cellular level

Of the forms of carnitine, acetyl-L-carnitine crosses the blood-brain barrier into the brain's mitochondria, a dense source of them and a really important area to fuel: it impacts both mental and physical energy directly
Acetyl-L-carnitine ramps up energy production
Acetyl-L-carnitine increases endurance
Acetyl-L-carnitine boosts the mitochondria's ability to burn fat, both for losing fat and for using fat as fuel, "which is the most effective fuel for our body"
Acetyl-L-carnitine is absolutely one of the personal favorites, relatively inexpensive
Personally, acetyl-L-carnitine is one to really try not to be without, other than just occasionally cycling off
Used by our body at such a fundamental level, acetyl-L-carnitine seems to have a long-term place in our lives
Alpha GPC, one of the personal top five supplements for real, healthy energy, is a source of choline, in simple terms essentially fuel in our brain, and critical: a really important nutrient we need
Choline comes from diet, like eggs, but a lot of us are deficient, and supplementing has some amazing benefits
Brain and body are so connected, and for alpha GPC there's a lot of science around things like increased power output
Personally, alpha GPC has a tremendous physical impact in addition to fueling the brain: a tremendous overall energy boost, in a healthy way
Of the forms of choline, such as CDP choline, alpha GPC has personally been the best
Timing: alpha GPC tends to take about two hours for maximum benefits, so take it a couple hours before your workout

Unlike alpha GPC, the other four of the personal top five energy supplements (coffee, acetyl-L-carnitine, cordyceps and shilajit) take effect within about 15 to 30 minutes, once digested, a great window pre-workout
All or most of the personal top five energy supplements, depending on what is being short-term cycled off, make the pre-workout mix on an almost daily basis
Cordyceps, one of the personal top five supplements for real, healthy energy, is a mushroom
Of the ton of beneficial mushrooms, like reishi and lion's mane, cordyceps is really the most well known for physical sort of power and energy
Personally, nothing gets taken or recommended now without science behind it
Cordyceps is a really, truly ancient medicine, used by humans for a really long time, with a lot of modern science too
Unlike alpha GPC, a very specific nutrient, cordyceps has a little more wide-ranging impacts, as adaptogens and mushrooms benefit the body in multiple ways
A main impact of cordyceps is energy on a fundamental, cellular kind of level: it has been shown very effective at boosting ATP, a molecule really essential for delivering energy to our body
Lots of studies show VO2 max, aerobic ability, improving with cordyceps
There are studies on anti-aging and anti-cancer properties of cordyceps
Personally, cordyceps truly increased physical energy and endurance: doing more and feeling better, day after day, on it than off it

Another favorite thing about cordyceps: it really increases lung function noticeably, with some science, and most definitely noticed personally: breathing is naturally deeper and stronger, sometimes striking when restarting after cycling off
For any breathing, lung or congestion issue, cordyceps is amazing

Shilajit, one of the personal top five supplements for real, healthy energy, very likely not heard of: an almost tar-like, sticky substance that squeezes out of rocks in the mountains, primarily the Himalayas, basically really, really old plant material condensed and treated by the earth over time
Shilajit is highly nutrient dense, with 80-plus minerals, so you only need a really, really small amount
Shilajit has fulvic acid, of which it is pretty much the best source
Fulvic acid, of which shilajit is pretty much the best source, is an antioxidant that helps the body in a number of ways: it does lots of things in our body
Fulvic acid, of which shilajit is pretty much the best source, is an antioxidant that helps the body in a number of ways, including getting rid of toxins
Fulvic acid, of which shilajit is pretty much the best source, is an antioxidant that helps the body in a number of ways, including fighting off reactions that cause allergy symptoms
Fulvic acid, of which shilajit is pretty much the best source, is an antioxidant that helps the body in a number of ways, including reducing inflammation
Fulvic acid, of which shilajit is pretty much the best source, is an antioxidant that helps the body in a number of ways, including preventing the growth of cancer
Fulvic acid, of which shilajit is pretty much the best source, stimulates the immune system
Quality: shilajit has a number of good brands, but a suggestion: be a little bit careful, as shilajit is one of those to be careful with, and cordyceps is kind of also this way
Definitely look for quality cordyceps: there are a number of good quality companies, so pay attention that you actually buy one of those
For alpha GPC, acetyl-L-carnitine and coffee, pretty much most companies are relatively good, though look for organic coffee when you can
With shilajit, spend some extra time on quality: there's a lot of lower quality out there, especially blends that supposedly include it, which often have very poor quality or not much of it

Shilajit is probably different from anything you've ever taken, and maybe the most powerful supplement personally taken in terms of truly feeling it: within a day, or a moderate amount the first time, it's really powerful for overall energy
A lot of science on shilajit: it benefits and reduces Alzheimer's disease
A lot of science on shilajit: it improves low testosterone and chronic fatigue
A lot of science on shilajit: it is used against high altitude sickness
A lot of science on shilajit: it helps fight iron deficiencies
A lot of science on shilajit: it improves fertility and heart health
Personally, shilajit has powerful energy benefits: highly suggested
The personal top five energy supplements, found in all the research and experimentation, come with an invitation to try any or all: "They're all safe and awesome and I think would benefit you"
